regression: With mem and module_core both present, native previously returned base 0x18000 and size 4096 instead of reference base 0x19000 and size 2048. The regression test failed before the fix.
limitations: Layout vectors use synthetic field adapters in the reference and actual native fixture reads; they do not establish complete module list or fault behavior.
Native Lsmod still has three columns; the pinned reference has six, including load arguments, taints and file output. Code size also includes init size in the reference.
Dump mode and damaged-list behavior remain outstanding; no full plugin contract is claimed.
